notes: Three «ح» branches end at يحيى بن سعيد, وكيع and ابن بشر; the names «مسعر ... عمرو بن حريث» are written once and belong to all three
«- واللفظ له -» is an editor's gloss, left out; the و of «ووكيع» is not in this report's surfaces
«أنه سمع النبي» : Amr is the last link; the Prophet is the end of the chain
